caveats: The pixel check and the shard re-hash ran in the same notebook session that built the cache. They show that the cache reproduces the PNG pipeline and that every shard reproduces index.json; they do not show that the saved Kaggle dataset is intact after upload. Run --verify on the attached dataset (acceptance item 3 again) before relying on it.
Acceptance items 4 and 5 (data-wait share on the cache backend from round 2 onward, and the side-by-side lite run) need a GPU run and are not part of this record.

The trial's single shard of 2000 images ran in one worker process, so its 26.6 images/s is a one-process rate, not a four-process rate; its printed projection (70 min) does not describe the full build.

Folder scan time varied between sessions (290 s in the 2026-10-11 profile run, 124.7 s in the trial, 60.4 s in the full build); it is a property of the Kaggle file system at the time, not of the build code.
